IRS990.ActivityOrMissionDesc: OUR MISSION IS TO NURTURE CHILDREN'S INNATE ABILITY TO LEARN BY CHALLENGING THEM ACADEMICALLY, CREATIVELY AND INNOVATIVELY, WHILE IMMERSING THEM IN THE ITALIAN LANGUAGE AND MAKING THEM KEENLY AWARE OF THE WORLD AROUND THEM AND THEIR PLACE IN IT.
IRS990.MissionDesc: INSPIRE BRAVE LEARNERS TO SHAPE THE FUTURE.
IRS990.Desc: LA SCUOLA OFFERS AN INTERNATIONAL, INQUIRY-BASED, LANGUAGE IMMERSION CURRICULUM FOR PRESCHOOL-GRADE 8 STUDENTS. STUDENTS LEARN ACROSS LANGUAGES, CULTURES AND SUBJECTS, WHILE FOSTERING CRITICAL AND CREATIVE THINKING SKILLS, CONFIDENCE, COLLABORATION, AND EMPATHY, WITH AN ENROLLMENT OF ABOUT 440 AND GROWING EVERY YEAR.

SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: ONE DONOR DESIGNATED HIS DONATION FOR AN ENDOWMENT FUND, THE ORGANIZATION INTENDS TO ESTABLISH A FULL-PLEDGED ENDOWMENT FUND, GROW THE FUND, AND USE THE INVESTMENT EARNINGS TO HELP FUND THE SCHOOL'S FINANCIAL AID PROGRAM.

THE SCHOOL IS A QUALIFIED ORGANIZATION EXEMPT FROM FEDERAL INCOME AND CALIFORNIA FRANCHISE TAXES UNDER THE PROVISIONS OF SECTIONS 501(C)(3) OF THE INTERNAL REVENUE CODE ("IRC") AND 23701(D) OF THE CALIFORNIA REVENUE AND TAXATION CODE, RESPECTIVELY. THE SCHOOL HAS EVALUATED ITS CURRENT TAX POSITIONS AND HAS CONCLUDED THAT AS OF JUNE 30, 2025, THE SCHOOL DOES NOT HAVE ANY SIGNIFICANT UNCERTAIN TAX POSITIONS FOR WHICH A RESERVE WOULD BE NECESSARY.

OUR NON-DISCRIMINATION POLICY IS INCLUDED IN OUR ENROLLMENT MATERIALS. WE HAVE ALSO INCLUDED IN PRINT ADS AND VIA INDEPENDENT SCHOOLS ASSOCIATIONS. THE SCHOOL ALSO POSTS THE NON-DISCRIMINATORY POLICY ON THE WEBSITE HOMEPAGE.

THE PURPOSE OF LA SCUOLA'S TUITION ASSISTANCE PROGRAM IS TO PROVIDE FINANCIAL ASSISTANCE TO FAMILIES WHO CANNOT AFFORD THE FULL COST OF THE TUITION. DIVERSITY ENRICHES THE EDUCATIONAL OPPORTUNITY FOR ALL FAMILIES, AND PARTICIPATION OF A WIDE RANGE OF FAMILIES IS CRITICAL TO AN INCLUSIVE SCHOOL LIKE LA SCUOLA. TUITION ASSISTANCE IS OFFERED ON THE BASIS OF THE DEMONSTRATED FINANCIAL NEED OF THE FAMILY. GRANTS ARE AWARDED TO FAMILIES ACCORDING TO THEIR LEVEL OF NEED AS DETERMINED BY THE INDEPENDENT SCHOOL MANAGEMENT FINANCIAL AID FOR SCHOOL TUITION (FAST) PROGRAM, THAT PROVIDES OBJECTIVE, THIRD-PARTY FINANCIAL NEEDS ASSESSMENTS AND LA SCUOLA'S TUITION ASSISTANCE COMMITTEE. THERE ARE NO MERIT-BASED AWARDS.
THE HEAD OF SCHOOL RECEIVED AN ANNUAL HOUSING ALLOWANCE OF $50,000 DURING THE FISCAL YEAR.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 11B
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE DOCUMENT IS SHARED ELECTRONICALLY WITH ALL MEMBERS OF THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES AND THEN REVIEWED IN A BOARD OF TRUSTEES MEETING.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 12C
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: EACH DIRECTOR, MANAGER, PRINCIPAL, OFFICER, OR MEMBER OF A COMMITTEE WITH GOVERNING-DELEGATED POWERS IS ANNUALLY REQUIRED TO DISCLOSE ANY CONFLICTS OR POTENTIAL CONFLICTS. IF ANY POTENTIAL CONFLICTS ARISE IT IS FIRST DISCLOSED DURING A BOARD OR COMMITTEE MEETING AT WHICH THE INTERESTED PERSON WITH POTENTIAL CONFLICT IS IN ATTENDANCE. THE INTERESTED PERSON SHALL LEAVE THE MEETING WHILE THE DETERMINATION OF WHETHER A CONFLICT OF INTEREST EXISTS IS EITHER DISCUSSED OR VOTED UPON OR REFERRED TO THE COMMITTEE FOR FURTHER CONSIDERATION. THE DECISION-MAKING BODY WILL RECOMMEND AN APPROPRIATE COURSE OF ACTION TO PROTECT THE INTEREST OF THE SCHOOL. ALL DISCLOSURES AND THE OUTCOME OF THE DELIBERATION WILL BE RECORDED IN THE MINUTES OF THE DELIBERATIVE MEETING.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION B, LINE 15
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE DETERMINATION OF COMPENSATION IS DISCUSSED BY THE COMPENSATION/HR COMMITTEE OF THE BOARD OF TRUSTEES. THE COMPENSATION MUST THEN BEAGREED UPON AT A BOARD MEETING. THE CAL-ISBOA SALARY AND BENEFITS SURVEY IS PRESENTED TO THE BOARD, AND THE SALARY AND BENEFITS GUIDELINE ANDRANGE ARE USED AS A BASIS FOR THE FOLLOWING YEAR'S BUDGET. THE HEAD OF SCHOOL/EXECUTIVE DIRECTOR AND BUSINESS MANAGER DECIDE ON SALARIES ANDPRESENT THE BUDGET TO THE BOARD FOR APPROVAL.

SupplementalInformationDetail.FormAndLineReferenceDesc: FORM 990, PART VI, SECTION C, LINE 19
SupplementalInformationDetail.ExplanationTxt: THE ORGANIZATION MAKES ITS GOVERNING DOCUMENTS, CONFLICT OF INTEREST POLICY, AND FINANCIAL STATEMENTS AVAILABLE TO THE PUBLIC DURING THE TAX YEAR, UPON WRITTEN REQUEST.
